system.notes:
A mini-grenade for a grenade launcher (SR3 p.283): the Gas Grenade (Neuro-Stun VIII)'s effects, fired rather than thrown. It does not arm until it has travelled about five metres (SR3 p.118).

SR3 p.283, the Mini-grenade row applied to the Gas Grenade (Neuro-Stun VIII) row: Conceal 8, Weight .1, Availability 8/4 days +2, Cost 60¥ ×2, Street Index 2 +1. Legality 3-J. No blast.
system.areaEffect: A cloud of stun gas: everything within 10 m is exposed, for 2 Combat Turns (less in windy areas, at the gamemaster's discretion).
